description: Synthetic sesslint.canonical parity (parse_session_header, parse_session_event, parse_session, parse_session_lines, load_session_file, validate_rfc3339_utc).
known_parity_gaps: dump_session and dump_session_file encode sorted compact JSON inside model. reparse_identity_hashes hashes that JSON after dropping provenance fields. to_canonical_json and canonical_bytes encode a Payload or a SessionEvent, and content identity omits provenance fields. to_canonical_dict returns the dict for a SessionEvent or a map Payload. Other types and normalize_for_canonical_json still return a typed unavailable error. Python performs the real call — parity not required here.
The text after the colon in a JSON syntax error and in a UTF-8 decode error: parity on detail tail is not required.
FileNotFoundError versus SchemaError for a missing file: parity on exception type is not required; a missing-file vector may compare message text only.
Unicode Nd timestamp digits, a non-str timestamp, an int outside i64, a non-string object key, frozenset iteration order, and a set used as a payload container: parity not required here.
